notes: URGENT FIX: after-hours sell guard could be bypassed by a slow exit cycle. handleExit()/liquidatePositionSync() checked the market-hours clock once at the top of the function, then reused that stale snapshot across a per-account loop making several real Alpaca API calls - if the loop ran long enough, an order could still go out minutes after the close even with Allow After Hours off. Reported: a Combo greed-cut exit placed a market sell 9 minutes after close despite the setting being off. Fixed by re-checking the clock fresh immediately before each order dispatch.
